note: What a client sends once it has loaded and is ready to play. It comes unprompted, before any start of play reaches the client. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: moduleOne
fields.note: One of three values a client reports about software it has detected alongside itself. A client sends zero.

fields.name: tipChosen
fields.note: Which tip the client is set to show.

fields.name: tipDuration
fields.note: How long it stays, as an entry among the display times in the client's own settings rather than a length of time.

bits.name: tips
bits.note: Set while tips are wanted at all.

bits.name: reporting
bits.note: Set while the client reports on itself.

bits.name: loadingTips
bits.note: Set while tips are wanted while loading.

bits.name: playingTips
bits.note: Set while tips are wanted during play.

bits.name: debug
bits.note: Set while the client runs in a debugging state.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client returns them as the server sent them.

fields.name: moduleTwo
fields.note: The second of the three. A client sends zero.

fields.name: moduleThree
fields.note: The third. A client sends zero.

revisions.note: The tip fields carry VersionSync's tip bytes, each one outside its valid range negated (0 as -128), and tips cleared where any is. Playing a replay, a client sends all four as zero. The three module fields are always zero.
